translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aey chadar mein lipatney walay !
raat ka thora hissa chorr ker baqi raat mein ( ibadat kay liye ) kharray hojaya kero ,
raat ka aadha hissa ! ya aadhay say kuch kam kerlo ,
ya uss say kuch ziyada kerlo , aur Quran ki tilawat itminan say saaf saaf kiya kero .
hum tum per aik bhari kalam nazil kernay walay hain .
beyshak raat kay waqt uthna hi aisa amal hai jiss say nafs achi tarah kuchla jata hai , aur baat bhi behtar tareeqay per kahi jati hai .
din mein to tum lambi masroofiyat mein rawan dawan rehtay ho .
aur apney perwerdigar kay naam ka ziker kero , aur sabb say alag ho ker pooray kay pooray ussi kay ho raho .
woh mashriq o maghrib ka malik hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , iss liye ussi ko kaarsaz bana lo .
aur jo baaten yeh ( kafir log ) kehtay hain , unn per sabar say kaam lo , aur khoobsurti kay sath unn say kinara kerlo .
aur tumhen jhutlaney walay jo aesh o ishrat kay malik banay huye hain , unn ka moamla mujh per chorr do , aur unhen thoray din aur mohlat do .
yaqeen jano humaray paas bari sakht berriyan hain , aur dehakti hoi aag hai ,
aur galay mein phans janey wala khana hai , aur dukh denay wala azab hai ,
uss din jab zameen aur pahar laraz uthen gay , aur saray pahar ret kay bikhray huye today ban ker reh jayen gay !
. ( jhutlaney walo ! ) yaqeen jano hum ney tumharay paas tum per gawah banney wala aik Rasool ussi tarah bheja hai , jaisay hum ney firon kay paas aik Rasool bheja tha .
phir firon ney Rasool ka kehna nahi maana , to hum ney ussay aesi pakar mein ley liya jo uss kay liye zabardast wabal thi .
agar tum bhi naa maaney to phir uss din say kaisay bacho gay jo bacchon ko boorha bana dey ga
. ( aur ) jiss say aasman phatt parray ga . Allah kay waday ko to poora ho ker rehna hai .
yeh aik naseehat ki baat hai . abb jo chahye , apney perwerdigar ki taraf janey wala raasta ikhtiyar kerlay .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhara perwerdigar janta hai kay tum do tehai raat kay qareeb , aur kabhi aadhi raat aur kabhi aik tehai raat ( tahajjud ki namaz kay liye ) kharray hotay ho , aur tumharay sathiyon mein say bhi aik jamat ( aisa hi kerti hai )   aur raat aur din ki theek theek miqdaar Allah hi muqarrar farmata hai . ussay maloom hai kay tum uss ka theek hisab nhi rakh sako gay , iss liye uss ney tum per inayat farma di hai .   abb tum itna Quran parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho .   Allah ko ilm hai kay tum mein kuch log beemar hon gay , aur kuch doosray aesay hon gay jo Allah ka fazal talash kernay kay liye zameen mein safar ker rahey hon gay ,   aur kuch aesay jo Allah kay raastay mein jang ker rahey hon gay . lehaza tum uss ( Quran ) mein say utna hi parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho . aur namaz qaeem kero ,   aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah ko qarz do , acha wala qarz !   aur tum apney aap kay liye jo bhalai bhi aagay bhejo gay , ussay Allah kay paas jaker iss tarah pao gay kay woh kahen behtar halat mein aur baray zabardast sawab ki shakal mein mojood hai . aur Allah say maghfirat maangtay raho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
